meta.name: Miss King
meta.description: The daughter of a genius shogi player channels the pain of her father's abandonment and her mother's death to become an elite competitor.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A shogi player becomes obsessed with winning and leaves his family. Many years later, his daughter Asuka sees his success and takes drastic action.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Asuka despairs when she is falsely accused of robbery at her workplace and arrested. Her half-brother arrives and offers to help on one condition.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Intent on becoming the first female regular professional shogi player, Asuka enters an amateur tournament but loses. She begins training under Todou.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Asuka worries that misfortune will continue to befall those around her if she continues with shogi. Todou recalls his tragic past with the game.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Asuka joins another female shogi player named Yuna for a meal and hears about the pressure she is facing to give up playing shogi after marriage.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Todou visits the shogi association to get Asuka's ban repealed, but Kaori denies him. Later, he and Asuka visit a former shogi association president.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Amid the tabloid scandal, Shoichi tells the shogi association that Asuka is his daughter. Meanwhile, Asuka attempts the kishi admission test.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Asuka receives a manuscript of the content that was removed from Shoichi’s autobiography and learns the true reason why he walked out on his family.
